subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Monitoring Your Identity
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Monitoring Your Identity.

hook.text: You can check your credit report for free every week. Most people never check it at all.

buildup.text: Regular monitoring catches unauthorized accounts before thieves can cause major damage.

discovery.text: Many banks now offer free alerts for new account openings and large transactions.

twist.text: Identity monitoring services can help, but they detect theft after it happens — not prevent it.

climax.text: The best defense combines proactive freezes with regular monitoring of all three credit bureaus.

punchline.text: You can't stop what you don't notice.

quiz.question: How often can you check your credit report for free?
